# Tit for Tat

> Tit for Tat is a mobile app for couples to track childcare fairly. It logs
> morning and evening slots each day, shows a 6-month history at a glance, and
> keeps both parents in sync automatically via iCloud. Currently in TestFlight beta.

What it does:

- Logs morning and evening childcare slots each day for each parent.
- Displays a full 6-month history so both parents can see the split at a glance.
- Syncs automatically between devices via iCloud — no account required.

What it isn't: a general-purpose scheduling or calendar app. There are no reminders,
no third-party sharing, and no server-side data storage.
